dedupe_keys.name: us county healthcare supply access and opioid distribution panel

description: This repository combines US county-level healthcare capacity, service use, insurance coverage and demographic variables with opioid-distribution measures. Kevin Griffith and collaborators built the original 2006–2013 analytical panel from federal sources, including Area Health Resources Files, ARCOS and CDC records. Current Mendeley version 9 also includes historical and newer workforce-source files, R preparation scripts and data dictionaries in CSV, RDS, Stata and SAS formats. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is US counties, with different year ranges across components. The analytical data distinguish imputed and original values; several current inventory entries have zero reported size, so complete availability of every listed source file is unverified. These are limitations for longitudinal comparisons. Modellers could parameterise county healthcare capacity and demand scenarios. data-cms-provider-data-hospitals and data-hrsa-health-workforce-projections provide related official resources. No patient data, county tables or processing scripts were downloaded, and the combined data were not recalculated.
